title: Missing 'exp' Enforcement in JWT Token Verification
cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration
description: JWT tokens must explicitly require an 'exp' (expiration) claim during verification to prevent indefinite access using stolen or unexpiring tokens.
impact: If tokens do not require an expiration claim, an attacker holding a valid token can maintain persistent access indefinitely.
remediation: Configure jwt.decode with options={'require': ['exp']} to mandate token expiration timestamps.

evidence.description: Token decoded without requiring expiration claim.
evidence.raw_data: jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM]) # Insecure: missing options={'require': ['exp']}

evidence.description: Current implementation in backend/main.py.

title: Missing Role-Based Access Control on Modifying API Endpoints
cwe: CWE-285: Improper Authorization
description: State-modifying endpoints (POST) must enforce administrative authorization checks to prevent unauthorized state alteration or privilege escalation.
impact: Unprivileged users could submit unauthorized findings or register new users without administrative oversight.
remediation: Verify the authenticated user's role equals 'admin' before executing state modifications on all POST routes.

evidence.description: POST endpoint without role verification.
Verified POST routes: ['/users/', '/findings/']. Unprotected: []
evidence.raw_data:
if current_user.get('role') != 'admin':
    raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail='Admin privileges required')

title: Overly Permissive CORS Policy with Wildcard Methods and Headers
cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains
description: CORS configuration used wildcard '*' for allow_methods and allow_headers, unnecessarily widening the cross-origin attack surface.
impact: Permissive CORS policies can allow untrusted web applications to perform unintended HTTP methods and supply sensitive custom headers.
remediation: Restrict allow_methods to explicitly needed verbs (GET, POST, OPTIONS) and allow_headers to standard required headers.

evidence.description: Wildcard CORS configuration.
Strictly narrowed CORS allow_methods and allow_headers.

title: Hardcoded Insecure Default Password Fallback for Administrator Account
cwe: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password
description: The application previously had a fallback default admin password ('admin123') in code if the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable was not set.
impact: Default credentials allow unauthorized users to gain immediate administrative control over the security assessment platform.
remediation: Refuse to start the server if ADMIN_PASSWORD is unset or equals the known default 'admin123'. Mandate strong password configuration via environment variables.

evidence.description: Hardcoded default fallback in code.
Strict check requiring explicit non-default ADMIN_PASSWORD.

title: Unrestricted Account Registration Without Admin Authorization
cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization
description: The POST /users/ route allowed open user creation without administrative authorization, allowing any actor to register accounts.
impact: Unrestricted registration exposes internal endpoints and increases the attack surface for credential stuffing and privilege escalation.
remediation: Restrict POST /users/ so only authenticated users with the 'admin' role can create accounts.

evidence.description: Open registration route without authorization.
Restricted to authenticated admin users only.

title: Missing Account ID Verification in Tier-1 News Feeds (8 channels)
cwe: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
description: Audited 8 Tier-1 intelligence feed channels across news_channels.json and news_channels_x.json missing verified numeric 'accountId' values. Unverified handles silently degrade feed integrity and are susceptible to identity forking if handles are renamed.
impact: An attacker could claim a dropped or renamed handle and inject disinformation directly into Tier-1 intelligence feeds, triggering false incident alerts.
remediation: Enforce strict schema validation on configuration files. Require all Tier-1 enabled feeds to contain verified numeric 'accountId' values validated against the provider API.

title: Exposure of Critical Infrastructure Coordinates (100 facilities)
cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
description: The application dataset contains geographical coordinates for 100 critical infrastructure / irradiation facilities. Aggregating precise coordinates of nuclear/radiological infrastructure poses a serious physical security risk if accessed by unauthorized actors.
impact: Unrestricted access to exact facility coordinates could allow malicious actors to locate and target radiological facilities.
remediation: Implement role-based precision masking on coordinates. Round coordinates to a coarse grid (0.5 degrees) with deterministic noise for standard users, and restrict precise coordinates to authorized admins.

title: Raw Critical Infrastructure Datasets Present in Build Context
cwe: CWE-552: Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
description: Raw IAEA DIIF database exports containing unmasked nuclear facility coordinates must not be present in the Docker build context or committed to repository tracking.
impact: Any files copied into the Docker container image during build (COPY dataset/ dataset/) can be extracted from public container registries or compromised containers.
remediation: Move raw unmasked dataset files to a gitignored 'private/' directory excluded via .dockerignore and .gitignore. Only include synthetic or fuzzed datasets (iaea_diif_db_safe.json) in the container image.

title: Vulnerable Frontend Dependencies Detected (3 packages via npm audit)

evidence.description: Vulnerable package: follow-redirects (Severity: high)
Vulnerable package: source-map-js (Severity: high)

  "package": "vite",
  "severity": "high",

    "launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows",

  ],
  "range": "8.3.0 - 8.3.2"
}

title: Missing 'exp' Enforcement in JWT Token Verification
cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration
description: JWT tokens must explicitly require an 'exp' (expiration) claim during verification to prevent indefinite access using stolen or unexpiring tokens.

remediation: Configure jwt.decode with options={'require': ['exp']} to mandate token expiration timestamps.
